instruction: A candid documentary wide shot captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor, white walls, and a radiator in the background. The man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, facing forward. The woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the right, leaning forward. She pushes the man's back with both hands. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead fluorescent lighting, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
